paragraphs.text: Tianjin Binhai International Airport (TSN/ZBTJ) serves as a key air gateway for Tianjin, CN, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 16R/34L: 3600 m (11811 ft) concrete, 16L/34R: 3200 m (10499 ft) concrete.
Ground transportation options connecting Tianjin Binhai International Airport with central Tianjin include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from TSN should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Tianjin Binhai International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Tianjin Binhai International Airport is TSN and the ICAO code is ZBTJ.

faqs.q: Which city does TSN airport serve?
faqs.a: Tianjin Binhai International Airport (TSN) serves Tianjin, CN.
